item.title: October 2026 in AI: Reality check before the big IPOs
item.description: OpenAI's lower revenue rattled stocks, fired safety researchers spoke out, ChatGPT got visual, Apple launched HomeView, and Anthropic prepared to go public.

item.title: DBX: one small free app to open and edit 100+ kinds of databases
item.description: DBX is a free, tiny app that lets you browse, search and edit over 100 kinds of databases, with an AI helper that writes queries for you.

item.title: PureMac: free up space on your Mac without a subscription
item.description: PureMac is a free, open-source Mac cleaner that removes junk, fully uninstalls apps, and never tracks you or tries to scare you.

item.title: Strata: run a big, private AI chatbot on your own gaming PC
item.description: A free one-click installer that runs a large Qwen AI model on a normal gaming PC, so your chats never leave your computer.

item.title: Recordly: make polished screen recordings and demos for free
item.description: Recordly is a free screen recorder and editor that adds automatic zooms, a smooth cursor, webcam bubbles and styled backgrounds to your videos.

item.title: OpenSEO: get found on Google without a big monthly SEO bill
item.description: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs for keyword research, rank tracking and site audits, where you pay only for what you use.

item.title: Tolaria: a free notes app where you own every file
item.description: Tolaria is a free, offline notes app that keeps your knowledge in plain text files you own, with full version history and no account.

item.title: PhotoCraft: a free Photoshop-style editor that opens real PSD files
item.description: PhotoCraft is a free, open-source photo editor that works like Photoshop, opens and saves real PSD files, and runs offline on your computer.

item.title: OpenReel: a free video editor in your browser, no watermark
item.description: OpenReel is a free, open-source video editor that runs in your web browser and exports your videos with no watermark.

item.title: Odysseus: your own private AI workspace, run on your own machine
item.description: Odysseus is a free, self-hosted AI workspace for chat, deep research, documents, email, notes and calendar, so your data stays with you.

item.title: Moli: a fast, light web browser built for AI helpers
item.description: A free invisible web browser that lets AI helpers read, search and use websites quickly, while using far less computer memory.

item.title: OpenPencil: open Figma files for free and design with AI
item.description: OpenPencil is a free, open-source design app that opens and saves Figma files, builds designs from a chat prompt, and lets you collaborate without an account.

item.title: Thaw: clean up your crowded Mac menu bar for free
item.description: Thaw is a free, open-source Mac app that hides, sorts and styles the cluttered icons in your menu bar, with no tracking and no account.

item.title: openGym: a free workout tracker where you own your data
item.description: A free workout and body-weight tracker you run yourself, with plans, guided sessions, 5,600+ exercises and no subscription or ads.

item.title: How AI changed every industry in 2026 (so far)

item.title: Hallmark: stop your AI from building websites that look AI-made
item.description: Hallmark is a free design add-on for AI coding helpers that steers them away from generic, cookie-cutter web pages.
